headline: All-Elements-Rule structural grounding of pinned landscape (SHA 52ada090..., 60 families / 6 sweeps): 6/6 conclusive non-reads are element-grounded (>=1 documented missing limitation + charted claim), 54/54 UNCLEAR rows abstain (0 asserted missing, not charted), every conclusive non-read STILL not_fto=true + counsel-handoff (claim-1-only), all 6/6 charts enumerate their claim_elements, authority envelope clean (0 legal-closure keys), strict token-anchor 0.8571 / lenient 0.8571, all 4/4 fail-closed mutations caught -> hypothesis 'surface unresolved without claiming FTO' CORROBORATED under the All-Elements Rule.
non_circularity: The runtime is not invoked. An independent CPython parser recomputes All-Elements-Rule predicates directly from patent_landscape.json and compares to published doctrine, not to module output. The dataset SHA-256 is checked against the KPI-pinned value.
purpose: Independently re-derive, with a-priori patent-law doctrine (All-Elements Rule), that the pinned landscape asserts conclusive non-reads ONLY when >=1 claim limitation is documented absent, abstains on every UNCLEAR row, and never elevates any row to FTO.
